name: sparx — Independent Bookshop
tagline: A warm, working storefront for an independent bookshop.
description: A complete, working shop for an independent bookshop: a real catalogue of staff-picked books, a canvas tote, a bookmark set, a gift card and a hand-picked book-club subscription, with categories, collections, a bespoke literary PDP and a full merchandised home page led by staff picks. Warm foxed-paper theme — cream ground, deep oxblood, an ink accent on rubrics and links. Shipped as Marginalia Books.
